description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of data within the Darija Open Dataset, specifically showing the counts for different data categories. The chart contains five slices, each representing a distinct category. The largest slice, colored green, is labeled “Pending Translations” and represents a count of 45,387. A grey slice labeled “Semantic Categories (e.g., Food, Economy)” accounts for 30,000 data points. The next slice, colored yellow, is labeled “Syntactic Roles (e.g., Verbs, Nouns, Adjectives)” and represents 23,108 data points. A smaller orange slice is labeled “Moroccan Names”. The smallest slice, colored blue, is labeled “Extra + Augmented Data”. The chart includes a legend identifying each category and its corresponding color, and numerical values are displayed directly within the grey, yellow, and green slices. The slices appear to be ordered visually from largest to smallest, based on their corresponding counts.
